commitResults.messageTitle: User Guide: Clarify commands and selection flow
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide leaves parts of the student, plan, and exercise selection
flow unclear. Clarify which commands require a selection, add missing
quick-start examples, and group commands available without a selection.

Document strict command syntax and the single-word tag constraint.

commitResults.messageTitle: Standardise plan and exercise command formats
commitResults.messageBody:
The User Guide uses inconsistent placeholders for plan and exercise
names. Plan examples also describe individual exercises.

Use PLAN_NAME and EXERCISE_NAME throughout the command reference,
and show plan descriptions with the intended --description option.
The command implementation will be updated separately.

Nested workout and exercise updates resolve the stored student before
building a replacement, then setStudent repeats the same lookup.

Extract the replacement logic into a private helper so model updates
validate only once.

Add regression coverage for missing targets and retained plans.

commitResults.messageTitle: docs: Complete DG manual testing instructions
commitResults.messageBody:
The manual testing appendix contains placeholders and gives testers
little guidance through BrotherGym's features.

Replace it with an ordered walkthrough covering students, workout
plans, exercises, validation, persistence, and recovery. Include
copy-paste inputs and expected results while referring to the user
guide for command syntax.

commitResults.messageTitle: DG: Clarify Model behavior and diagrams
commitResults.messageBody:

relations, and diagram notes that distract from the main flow.

Clarify validation, entity construction, and stored data updates.
Restore the incoming Model connection and all/filtered student
relations, and simplify notes around the sequence diagrams.

commitResults.messageTitle: Docs: Correct homepage and website navigation
commitResults.messageBody:
The homepage contains outdated AB3 content and badges. Website
navigation links also point to AB3 or incorrect guide sections.

Update the homepage to describe BrotherGym and correct the badges
and navigation links so readers reach the intended pages.

The Developer Guide contains a placeholder instead of credits for
reused project material and development tools.

Credit AddressBook-Level3 and acknowledge Codex, Claude, GitHub
Copilot and the libraries used by BrotherGym.
